summary: The community focuses on the Monaco ePrix, highlighting the performances of drivers Hughes and Rast, as well as Barnard's debut. Hughes qualified second and finished fifth, while Rast finished seventeenth after multiple collisions. Barnard also made his debut at the Monaco ePrix and later finished tenth at the Berlin ePrix. Hughes transitioned from McLaren to Maserati MSG Racing in 2024.

key_statements.statement: Hughes qualified in second and finished fifth at the Monaco ePrix, while Rast finished seventeenth after multiple collisions.
Barnard made his debut at the Monaco ePrix and later finished Race 1 in tenth at the Berlin ePrix.
Hughes left McLaren to join Maserati MSG Racing in 2024.
